items.name: resize-handle
items.title: Resize Handle & Panel Reopen Tab
items.description: Shell Resize Handle (the 12px drag edge of a resizable panel: invisible at rest, stroke-strong on hover, info-primary while dragging or focused) and Panel Reopen Tab (20×56 tab flush with the canvas edge when a panel is closed; click reopens at the default width, drag pulls it out). Used by AppShell.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Shell App Shell: shared chrome for every urbanflow product (urbanflow, Flux). A top bar, then a canvas full-bleed behind a left panel, floating canvas tools (AppShellPin top-right / bottom-centre / bottom-right) and a right panel, 8px inset. The shell owns both panel widths: they open at the product defaults every session (left urbanflow 252 / Flux 360, right 359 / 300), resize by dragging their inner edge with no maximum, always keep a 24px gap (growing one squeezes the other), close when dragged to 0 with a reopen tab on that edge, and are never saved. Canvas tools hide when there isn't room. Products fill the slots; modes and tools go on the canvas, never as tabs in the top bar.

items.name: top-navigation
items.title: Top Navigation
items.description: Shell Top Navigation: 44px dark bar with the product logo and the urbanflow TopNav project bar (project switcher menu, open proposal and its status, notifications, collaborators, credits). product="flux" hides notifications and collaborators.

items.name: proposal-badge
items.title: Proposal Badge
items.description: Shell Proposal Badge and Proposal Title: proposal status (Draft, Behind main, In review, Changes suggested, Ready for merge, Merged, Closed shown as Archived) and the proposal name with its badges on the dark top bar.

items.name: utilities-toolbar
items.title: Utilities Toolbar
items.description: Shell Utilities Toolbar: floating rail of large icon buttons pinned top-right of the canvas. urbanflow puts its analysis tools here; Flux puts its modes (Model, HVAC, Weather, Runs, Results, Files), one selected at a time.

items.name: left-context-panel
items.title: Left Context Panel
items.description: Shell Left Context Panel: the AppShell's left panel. product="urbanflow" (252px: page switcher menu, optional tabs, scrolling Building / Floor / Zone sections) or product="flux" (360px: children fill the panel, e.g. the chat). Inside AppShell it fills the width the shell gives it (resizable, collapsible); on its own it uses its default width.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: urbanflow Progress: 4px bar, background-medium track and texticons-primary fill (Radix Progress, value 0–100).

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: urbanflow Separator: 1px stroke-subtle divider, horizontal or vertical (Radix Separator).

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: urbanflow Hover Card: card that opens on hover or focus of its trigger (Radix HoverCard), white with shadow-md and a stroke-subtle edge.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: urbanflow Command: searchable list (cmdk) with Action List styling: input, groups, items, empty state, separator, shortcut. Use for pickers and palettes.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: urbanflow Collapsible (Radix): Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger (focus ring, pointer) and CollapsibleContent (collapsible-up / -down animation, none with reduced motion). Unstyled otherwise; the AI trace, reasoning and sources build their rows on it.

items.name: ai-context-chip
items.title: AI Context Chip
items.description: urbanflow AI Context Chip: an object or file attached to a prompt. status attached / uploading (spinner) / sent (read-only) / error (retry), icon, label, detail, onRemove, onRetry. AIContextSelectionChip takes a generic { kind, label, count } selection; AIContextChipAdd starts picking context. The app owns uploads and passes the status.

items.name: ai-context-usage
items.title: AI Context Usage
items.description: urbanflow AI Context Usage: 16px ring with % (from used / limit) that opens a hover card (context window %, bar, tokens used of limit, optional input, output, credits). AIContextUsageCard on its own. AIContextLimit shows the nearly-full banner (from nearlyFullAt, default 75%) and the full banner, with a New chat button only when onNewChat is passed. contextUsage() returns the same percent and state.

items.name: ai-prompt-input
items.title: AI Prompt Input
items.description: urbanflow AI Prompt Input (AI Elements PromptInput on Flow): context chips row, auto-growing textarea (Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line, max 6 lines), toolbar with attach, mode / model / effort pills (a dropdown only when there are two or more options, a static label for one, hidden for none), context usage and Send / Stop (status ready / submitted / streaming / error, like useChat). Enter does not send while generating unless submitWhileGenerating is set. AIPromptInputPicker floats a Command list above it for @ and / pickers; give the textarea role=combobox, aria-expanded and aria-controls when you open one. Presentational: state and callbacks come from the app.

items.name: ai-code-block
items.title: AI Code Block
items.description: urbanflow AI Code Block (Figma AICodeBlock): plain monospace block for code and error details in AI output, Background/Light, 12px radius, wraps long lines. No syntax highlighting.

items.name: ai-trace
items.title: AI Trace
items.description: urbanflow AI Trace (Figma AITrace · Chain of thought): the tool calls of one assistant turn as a single collapsible summary with one level of steps. steps: { id, name, label, status pending / running / done / error, detail?, input?, output?, attempt? }; toolPartStatus(part) maps an AI SDK tool part (state, preliminary) to a status. The summary reads Researching · Step n of N, Researched in N steps, Research stopped at step n (only while the failed step blocks the rest), Retrying / Retry failed (attempt > 1), or Stopped at step n when stopped is set after the user stops the reply; label overrides it. Opens while running or failed and closes otherwise, unless the user toggled it. A failed step opens to its detail (AICodeBlock) and Retry (onRetry). toolRenderers maps a tool name to a component ({ step }) drawn under that step at any status.

items.name: ai-reasoning
items.title: AI Reasoning
items.description: urbanflow AI Reasoning (Figma AITrace · Reasoning): Thinking with a spinner while status is running, Thought · 5s when complete (duration in seconds). Collapsed by default; children are the reasoning text (pass rendered markdown).

items.name: ai-sources
items.title: AI Sources
items.description: urbanflow AI Sources (Figma AISources): Used N sources, expanding to one row per source (icon, title, detail). sources: { id, title, detail?, href?, icon? }; parts.filter(isAISourcePart).map(toAISource) maps AI SDK source-url and source-document parts. onSelect makes rows buttons; otherwise rows with href open in a new tab.

items.name: ai-citation-card
items.title: AI Citation Card
items.description: urbanflow AI Citation (Figma AICitationCard): AICitation is an inline citation badge that previews a hover card on hover or focus; AICitationCard lays out the card: icon, title, description and an optional action such as a plain Open in Costflow button. The card can't be reached by keyboard or touch, so also give AICitation an onClick that opens the source. AICitations wraps a row of badges.

items.name: ai-message
items.title: AI Message
items.description: urbanflow AI Message (Figma AIMessage): AIMessage from user (right-aligned bubble, put an AIContextChip with status sent above AIMessageContent) or assistant (no bubble). AIMessageContent takes the rendered body (e.g. a Streamdown element). AIMessageGenerating shows Thinking and skeleton lines; AIMessageActions holds AIMessageCopy (shows Copied for 2 s) and AIMessageRegenerate (latest reply only); AIMessageStopped and AIMessageError (connection lost, with Retry) end a reply that did not finish.

items.name: ai-conversation
items.title: AI Conversation
items.description: urbanflow AI Conversation: the scrolling message list. Sticks to the latest message while you are at the bottom and stays put when you scroll up; AIConversationScrollButton (Figma Scroll to latest) shows only when scrolled up and smooth-scrolls back. Built on use-stick-to-bottom.

items.name: ai-approval-card
items.title: AI Approval Card
items.description: urbanflow AI Approval Card (Flux's approval card on Flow; no Figma frame yet): asks before the agent changes something. title (the tool or the change, e.g. Edit model.epJSON), detail (one sentence on why), an optional body as children (an AIApprovalDiff per file, a script, a list of paths) and actions, an ordered list of { id, label, variant primary / secondary / tertiary, tone default / critical / success, title?, disabled?, onSelect } so each app picks its buttons (Approve and Deny; or Allow once, Allow <tool> in this project, Full auto, Deny). Set disabled while a decision is in flight. Buttons sit in an auto-fit grid that stacks them when the panel is narrow, and long labels wrap. status requesting / decided / denied / stopped: once answered the card shrinks to a one-line record (title · outcome, default You allowed this. / You declined this. / Stopped before this was answered. Nothing was changed.), with an Auto badge when auto is set on a decided card; actions can be left out there. A keyboard user who answers lands on the record. AIApprovalDiff draws one file's unified diff: path, new file, +added / -removed and coloured lines. Presentational: the app owns the gate and the decision.

items.name: ai-question-card
items.title: AI Question Card
items.description: urbanflow AI Question Card (Flux's ask_user card on Flow; no Figma frame yet): the agent's questions inline in the chat. questions: { id, prompt, placeholder?, kind } with single { options, recommended?: string, allowOther? }, multi { options, recommended?: string[], allowOther? }, text { recommended?: string } or number { recommended?: number }; options are { value, label, description? }. title is the sentence on why it asks, image an optional { src, alt } above the questions. All questions show at once: single is a radio list, multi a checkbox list, text and number a field; allowOther adds one free-text field per question (typing in it clears a single choice). The starting answer is answers[id] when given, else recommended, which is also marked Recommended. Submit (onSubmit({ answers, skipped })) is disabled until something is answered; Enter in a text field or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter anywhere submits, while plain Enter on a choice does nothing. Skip shows when onSkip is set. status asking / timed-out (the form stays answerable under note, default The agent went ahead with the recommended answers. Answer now and it changes course.) / answered (each prompt with its answer label, or Skipped, from answers; a keyboard user lands on it). Key the card by request id so a new request starts fresh. The core app's ask_user (one question, 2-4 options, free text) is one single question with allowOther.

items.name: ai-pending-banner
items.title: AI Pending Banner
items.description: urbanflow AI Pending Banner: the sticky Waiting for you bar above the composer while an approval or question card waits for an answer. children says what is waiting (e.g. Approve Edit model.epJSON); count shows a number badge above 1, and at 0 the bar is gone; onJump (jumpLabel, default Show) is where the app scrolls to the card and focuses it. Keep it mounted at count 0: a hidden status region stays in place so screen readers announce each new wait. Sticks to the bottom of its scroll container.

items.name: ai-message-queue
items.title: AI Message Queue
items.description: urbanflow AI Message Queue: messages typed while the agent works, waiting above the composer. items: { id, text, editable? }; the header reads N queued, with an optional note (e.g. sent when the agent is free), and collapses the list (open / defaultOpen true / onOpenChange). Each row has Move up and Move down (onReorder gets the whole new id order), Edit (onEdit(id, text); a growing field keeps line breaks, Enter saves, Shift+Enter adds a line, Escape cancels, leaving it unchanged or empty keeps the old text), Send now (onSendNow) and Remove (onRemove); a control shows only when its callback is set, the row actions appear on hover, keyboard focus or touch, and focus moves to the next row when one leaves. Renders nothing when the queue is empty.
